task.description:
Validate that PD-09 is ready for release.

Check:
1. All TC-PD-09-01 through TC-PD-09-07 passed (or were skipped due to BPM_TEST_DB_URL not being set) in the test report at `tests/reports/WF02-pd09-20260521-run-01.md`.
2. All 4 PD-09 acceptance criteria from `docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md` §PD-09 are covered by at least one test case.
3. `zig build` exits 0 — run it yourself to verify.
4. No OWASP Top 10 violations (especially SQL injection) in `src/definition/export_import.zig`. Check that all SQL queries use parameterised placeholders ($1, $2) and no user-supplied values are interpolated into query strings.
5. `src/api/routes/definitions.zig` contains `handleExport` and `handleImport` handlers.
6. `src/bpm.zig` exports `pub const export_import`.

Apply the same BPM_TEST_DB_URL skip precedent as PD-08: if integration tests are skipped due to infrastructure only (no code defects), this is an acceptable PASS.

If all checks pass: set result.status = PASS and result.next_action = "Route to DOC-UPDATER".
If any check fails: set result.status = FAIL and list all issues.
acceptance_criteria: All PD-09 test cases pass or are skipped (BPM_TEST_DB_URL infrastructure only)
All 4 PD-09 acceptance criteria are covered by test cases
No SQL injection vulnerabilities in export_import.zig
handleExport and handleImport present in definitions.zig

result.summary: Release APPROVED for PD-09 (Definition import/export). All 6 acceptance checks passed: zig build exits 0; TC-PD-09-const PASS; TC-PD-09-01 through TC-PD-09-07 skip (BPM_TEST_DB_URL not set, infrastructure constraint, acceptable per PD-08 precedent); all 4 PD-09 acceptance criteria covered by test cases; no SQL injection vulnerabilities in export_import.zig (all queries use parameterised placeholders); handleExport and handleImport present in definitions.zig (lines 384, 420); src/bpm.zig exports pub const export_import.
result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER to set PD-09 status RELEASED
